name: Guiyunju 8-Fang Mountain Lodge
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at Guiyunju 8-Fang Mountain Lodge?
address: Fangshancun Xie Ziyu No. 56, Wuxing District, Huzhou, Zhejiang, China
priceRange: Unbeatable daily deals - quickly find great rates for your ideal stay. And if it's cheaper elsewhere, we'll refund the difference.

comments.quote: 滿分，很滿意，各方面都很好，老闆人很好，居住環境很乾凈，應該是新裝修的，很新，房間有投影儀，可以手機投屏看電影，停車也方便（直接停在院子裏，很寬敞），房間裏三張床，一家人住特別好，早上有早餐，阿姨做好我們就去吃了，位置離庾村廣場也不算遠，開車幾分鐘就到了，整體好評，下次再去玩還訂
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: Full marks, very satisfied, good in every way. The owner is kind, the place is spotless and looks newly done, and there is a projector so you can cast a film from your phone. Parking is easy, right in the courtyard, which is generous. Three beds in the room, ideal for a family. Breakfast was ready when we came down. It is a few minutes drive from Yucun square. All round positive and I would book again.

comments.quote: 入住前聯繫老闆，服務很好告訴行程的天氣，也發了定位。房間打掃的很乾凈，有游泳池，孩子玩的很開心，晚上睡覺也不吵，離小鎮也很近。
comments.author: Putaobuchixiangcai
